"

*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: describe_image.py
+import base64
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from urllib import request
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions"
+OPENAI_MODEL = "gpt-4o-mini"
+
+
+def _read_image(image_path):
+    with open(image_path, "rb") as f:
+        return f.read()
+
+
+def describe_image(image_path):
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    image_bytes = _read_image(image_path)
+    image_b64 = base64.b64encode(image_bytes).decode("ascii")
+    payload = {
+        "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+        "messages": [
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": [
+                    {"type": "text", "text": "Write a short visual description of this image."},
+                    {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": f"data:image/jpeg;base64,{image_b64}"}},
+                ],
+            }
+        ],
+        "max_tokens": 60,
+    }
+
+    req = request.Request(
+        OPENAI_API_URL,
+        data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"),
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        method="POST",
+    )
+
+    with request.urlopen(req) as resp:
+        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
+
+    return data["choices"][0]["message"]["content"].strip()
+
+
+def main():
+    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
+        raise SystemExit("Usage: describe_image.py <image_path>")
+    print(describe_image(sys.argv[1]))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

Task: detects labels or objects in a static image.
Use one concrete external provider and make that provider identifiable in code.
"

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: detect_image_labels.py
+import base64
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import requests
+
+
+GOOGLE_VISION_ENDPOINT = "https://vision.googleapis.com/v1/images:annotate"
+
+
+def detect_labels(image_path: str):
+    api_key = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_VISION_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("GOOGLE_VISION_API_KEY is required")
+
+    data = Path(image_path).read_bytes()
+    payload = {
+        "requests": [
+            {
+                "image": {"content": base64.b64encode(data).decode("utf-8")},
+                "features": [{"type": "LABEL_DETECTION", "maxResults": 10}],
+            }
+        ]
+    }
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        GOOGLE_VISION_ENDPOINT,
+        params={"key": api_key},
+        json=payload,
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    result = response.json()
+    annotations = result.get("responses", [{}])[0].get("labelAnnotations", [])
+    return [
+        {"description": item.get("description"), "score": item.get("score")}
+        for item in annotations
+    ]
+
+
+def main():
+    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
+        raise SystemExit("usage: detect_image_labels.py IMAGE_PATH")
+
+    labels = detect_labels(sys.argv[1])
+    print(json.dumps(labels, indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch
